request: Read only Vault/GPG migration sources and tmpfs readiness with no sensitive values.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
l=/home/admin1/projects/libral-vault; v=/home/admin1/projects/astera_v8
body=VAULT_MIGRATION_READY_SCAN
for x in "$l" "$v"; do body="$body
SOURCE=$(basename "$x")|$(git -C "$x" branch --show-current)|$(git -C "$x" rev-parse HEAD)"; done
for x in /run/user/1000 /run/secrets /run/astera-v8; do if [ -d "$x" ]; then body="$body
RUN_DIR=$(basename "$x")|exists|$(stat -f -c '%T' "$x")"; fi; done
for x in /home/admin1/projects/gpg-core /home/admin1/gpg-core; do if [ -e "$x" ]; then body="$body
GPG_CORE_PATH_EXISTS=YES"; fi; done
body="$body
CLOUDFLARED_COUNT=$(docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -ic cloudflare || true)"
body="$body
VAULT_TUNNEL_API_SOURCE=$(grep -c 'astera-tunnel/materialize' "$l/src/server.ts" || true)"
body="$body
V8_ENV_TUNNEL_PATH=$(awk -F= '/^CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN_FILE=/{if ($2 ~ /^\/run\//) print "TMP_PATH";else if ($2 == "/dev/null") print "NULL";else print "OTHER"}' "$v/.env")"
gh api -X POST repos/G-ACE-inc/server-core/issues/10/comments -f body="$body" --jq '.html_url'
